title: 托福官方套题 10 · 口语

tasks.sample: (MA) Scan the barcode for each item on the belt.
(MA) You can also enter prices by hand.
(MA) Print the receipt for the customer by request only.
(MA) Use the card reading machine for all electronic payments.
(MA) Verify the amount before completing the transaction.
(MA) Make sure to keep the checkout area organized, well-stocked and clean at all times.
(MA) Before they leave, thank customers for their business and assist them as needed.

tasks.stem: (Interviewer) Thank you for your participation. I’d like to know about your reading habits. How do you usually get information or stay entertained—through reading, videos, conversations with others, or another way? Why does that approach work for you?
(Interviewer) I see. Can you recall a time when reading something—whether a book, article, or even a social media post—changed your perspective or taught you something new? Please explain.
(Interviewer) Interesting. Do you think reading is becoming more or less common in today’s world? What are some possible reasons for that change?
(Interviewer) Good points. One final question. In your opinion, how important is it to preserve older books and libraries in a digital world?
